dedupe_keys.name: ambulance victoria incidents 2011 19 statewide statistical summary

description: This small table summarises the workload of Ambulance Victoria, the state ambulance service of Victoria, Australia, over nine financial years. The producer is Ambulance Victoria, which publishes it through the DataVic portal. Coverage runs from 2010-11 to 2018-19 for the whole state, split into metropolitan and rural regions. It counts emergency road incidents by dispatch code (code 1 needs urgent lights-and-sirens care, code 2 is acute but not lights and sirens, code 3 is not urgent), non-emergency road transports, and air ambulance incidents by fixed-wing aircraft and by each helicopter base; in 2018-19 there were 618,125 emergency and 938,152 total road incidents. The file is available as one free CSV download under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: it holds annual aggregates only, with no locations, times or response performance; notes explain breaks in the series from secondary triage of calls from 2016, the move of rural dispatch to the state's emergency telecommunications authority in 2012 and new charging rules in 2014; and the series stops in 2018-19. Simulation uses: setting annual demand and code mix for ambulance fleet models, comparing metropolitan and rural workloads, and sizing air ambulance capacity. Related records: the NEMSIS research data set (data-nemsis-research-dataset) gives record-level ambulance data for the United States, and the CFA response times (data-cfa-emergency-response-times) cover Victorian fire services.
name: Ambulance Victoria Incidents 2011-19 (statewide statistical summary)
